messages:
jordana: Hey team — planning a lightweight OSS launch for 'SparkKit' (small starter/ref app + tutorial). Need a short launch post, a 30-min webinar plan, a benchmark narrative (latency/cost vs vanilla infra), and an inbound lead routing map. Can people volunteer for copy + assets + demo? :rocket:

alex: I can own the demo + quick perf checklist. Will capture end-to-end numbers on our Dedicated vs a single-cloud VM.

sam: I’ll draft the tutorial flow and accompanying repo README. Aim for a 10–15 min tutorial + 10-min hands-on in webinar.

jordana: Perfect — can you scope the tutorial steps? We want it beginner-friendly but shows batching/caching wins.

sam: Outline: 1) clone sparkkit, 2) run locally with small model, 3) enable Redwood Optimize presets (batching + cache), 4) run benchmark script and view dashboard. Add commands in README.

alex: For benchmarks I’ll produce two scripts: quick_run.sh (10 requests) and load_run.sh (1000 requests with concurrency). Will include token counts and cost calc snippet: `python cost_est.py --tokens 10000 --rate 0.0004`

katie: I can write the launch post draft (short, angle = "ship a starter app that shows real cost savings"). Need one quote from eng and one metric to highlight. Alex — can you pick the headline number?

alex: Headline suggestion: "SparkKit reduces per-request token cost by ~3x using Redwood Optimize presets vs baseline" (I'll attach the CSV and graphs).

mike: For the webinar, propose: 1) 5-min intro + positioning, 2) 10-min walkthrough of SparkKit, 3) 10-min demo + live benchmark, 4) 5-min Q&A. CTA: star repo, sign up for Dedicated trial — route to growth@redwood.com.

jordana: Good — inbound routing: marketing form -> growth triage -> demo sched if >50k tokens/day interest -> sales/solutions. For OSS leads, we send a follow-up tutorial email and invite to community office hours.

sam: Content assets I need: logo (png/svg), a short sample convo file, and a prebuilt Dockerfile for local run. Alex — can you add Dockerfile to repo?

alex: Yep. I'll push Dockerfile + perf scripts to `examples/sparkkit` by EOD.

katie: Draft launch post plan: 1) TL;DR + headline metric, 2) 2–3 screenshots (dashboard + code), 3) 3 bullets on how Redwood helps (batching, caching, routing), 4) link to repo + webinar CTA. I'll share first draft tomorrow.

jordana: Awesome. Content timeline: draft out tomorrow, review Wed, assets in by Thu, publish next Tue, webinar live Fri. Can everyone confirm timelines?

alex: Confirmed.

sam: Confirmed.

katie: Confirmed.

mike: Confirmed — I’ll set up the Growth routing and calendar invite after katie posts CTA.

content-bot: Reminder: use OSS launch checklist template: /oss-launch-checklist. Make sure license file (Apache-2.0) is included.

jordana: Thanks — adding license and checklist to repo tasks. If no blockers I’ll assign PRs and create the webinar event. :sparkles:
